findings.finding: The plan changes build_manifest to emit per-component `material-part:` lines but does not enumerate the parameter/call-site changes this requires. build_manifest currently receives only `material: str` (the one-way composite hash), so per-component parts must be passed in by callers. build_manifest has exactly two call sites — `attest.py:156` (sign_plan_review) and `attest.py:292` (the drift-refresh resign path) — and neither is listed as a patch site for feeding `material_components(ctx)` into the emitter. The manifest.py Scope entry says only 'emit and parse material-part: lines'; attest.py is scoped only for reason-string edits.
findings.location: Scope: `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py` — 'emit and parse material-part: lines'; Approach step 2
scenarios: attest.py:156 (sign_plan_review): if not updated to pass material_components(ctx), a freshly signed manifest carries no material-part: lines and explain_material_change silently degrades to the legacy pin-only path for brand-new attestations — the core feature under-delivers.

attest.py:292 (drift-refresh resign): this path has only the prior composite hash available; without an explicit source of per-component parts (from snapshot's ctx), a drift-refreshed manifest loses the material-part: lines, regressing an attestation that previously would carry them.
findings.suggested_fix: Add build_manifest to the manifest.py Scope entry as a signature change taking `material_parts: dict[str, tuple[str, int]]`, list attest.py:156 and attest.py:292 as patch sites in the attest.py Scope entry, and specify that the drift-refresh path computes material_components() from `snapshot`'s subject_state + child_ids (the same ctx from_snapshot builds) rather than from the prior composite.
